subtitle: Lesson 9 · T-SQL Foundations

caption: The same color comes back once per product — lots of duplicates.
Now each color appears exactly once, no matter how many products share it.

code:
SELECT DISTINCT Color, Size
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Red/Large and Red/Small are two different rows — DISTINCT compares the full combination.
Adding a column that varies per row (like a primary key) defeats DISTINCT entirely.
